notes.title: 🧙 Patch V1.1.06 – Quick Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just a quick update. 🧙



You can now hold Spacebar to speed up the game by 4x—as long as there aren’t any enemies nearby.

This should help the early waves move along a bit quicker if you're a faster typer.


⏩ Speeding Things Up a Bit
Hold Spacebar to speed up the game by 4x.

⚠️ Only works when no enemies are near the player



If you run into any issues please let me know by filling out the bug report form.



🐛 Bug Report Form: 

https://forms.gle/yzhvKXnHyR4UPFQP7



Thank you 🧙

notes.title: Spell Wizard Release Date & New Content Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 🧙‍♂️ 

I'm currently wrapping up development on Spell Wizard and I'd like to share some of the new content I've worked on for the full release, features that go beyond what you've experienced in the demo!

[previewyoutube=XyrEa37rywM;full][/previewyoutube]

🗺️ Maps and enemies!
New maps and enemies to fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45378912/a0b55c582379ece14510cea97c669e7d45d75e05.gif

🧊 Shatter
When defeating an enemy, there's a chance to freeze nearby enemies in place for a short time.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45378912/70e4e4226f2c93d3af863f2968f17c570ff10aff.gif

⚡Chain Lightning 
Your lightning attack has a chance to bounce to nearby enemies, knocking them back.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45378912/10a65d5baf1a3199d8c911cc489251dfd12cb753.gif

👻 Fear
When defeating an enemy, you strike fear into nearby enemies, causing them to flee for a brief period.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45378912/7e25670c25ed4fd07f7157cc31131991b25c5b8a.gif
and more....


👑New Gamemode: Endless Nightmare  
Fight against an Endless Nightmare of enemies, survive as long as possible, and claim a place in the top 100 on the in-game leaderboard!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45378912/7f2151ac9cb00129540e69e6829272e83efb0d77.gif


🗓️ Release Date!
With all of the new content covered, I am happy to announce that Spell Wizard will be releasing the 15th of July, 2025.


Thank you to everyone that wishlisted, played the demo and gave feedback! Can't wait to get the full game into your hands🧙‍♂️

notes.title: Spell Wizard Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 🧙‍♂️🪄

First of all, thank you so much for playing the demo and leaving feedback. I've been working hard to polish the full game, but I also wanted to bring some of these changes to the demo right away to ensure a better experience. 🤗

Tweaks & Improvements

 Smoother Boss Transition  – Space bar is no longer required when engaging bosses, ensuring a seamless transition from fighting normal enemies to bosses. Typing flow should now feel more natural.
 Improved Tutorial Visibility – Player instructions now appear in a pop-up window that pauses the game until closed, ensuring enough time to read them. This feature can be disabled in the settings.
 Typing SFX Toggle – You can now disable the typing sound effects in the settings.
 Expanded Word Variety – The list of 7-letter words has been updated to include a greater selection, enhancing diversity.
 New Menu Sound Effects! – Added new sound effects to the menu for a more polished experience. 


Bug fixes

 Gem Distribution – Fixed a bug that caused incorrect gem drops. Expect to collect more gems as originally intended.


Thanks for reading and stay tuned for more news.

notes.title: Spell Wızard Demo Patch Notes V1.0.02
notes.content:
Hello! 🧙🪄

First of all, thank you everyone for playing the demo and leaving tons of valueable feedback!
While I won't be adressing all of it in the demo, there are some fixes I wanted to get out as soon as possible.



 Fixed keyboard input for different language layouts. 
I was not able to recreate this issue on my end so I couldn't completely test to see if it is fixed, so please let me know if you still run into the issue where your keystrokes are not being registered properly due to having a different keyboard language layout.

 Fixed a bug that let you build up your HotStreak bar on the same elite enemy words over and over. 

 Decreased enemy wave length from 90 to 75 seconds due to complaints of fatigue.
